item.title: [DE|Primary] Ö1 Journal um acht (Thu 19:36): Abendjournal um 18 (08.10.2026)
[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): Sondierungsgespräche | Vier Tote bei Unfall | Fahrplanwechsel
item.description:
Originally published Thu 08 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Berliner Linke, Grüne und SPD haben Sondierungsgespräche über eine Koalition begonnen. Zuvor hatten sich die drei Parteien auf ein Papier zum Thema Antisemitismus geeinigt. Darin sind unter anderem ein Bekenntnis zum Schutz jüdischen Lebens und zum Existenzrecht Israels festgeschrieben. Weitere Themen: Vier Jugendliche auf Mopeds gestorben bei Kollision mit entgegenkommendem Auto im Barnim. Umfangreiche Änderungen im Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg zum Fahrplanwechsel. Und: Brandenburgischer Tourismustag in Potsdam.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Thu 18:49): Russian strike on buses in Ukraine kills at least 30
item.description:
Originally published Thu 08 Oct 2026 18:49 IDT.

At least 30 people have been killed in a Russian air strike at a bus stop in the eastern Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk. Eighteen others were wounded. The attack follows a dramatic surge in Russian attacks across the country and a heavy increase in civilian casualties. President Volodymyr Zelensky says the attacks will not go unanswered.

Also: Israel has downgraded the British consulate in East Jerusalem, after threatening to close the site completely over the UK's decision to sanction Israeli goods from illegal West Bank settlements. It’s been nearly a year since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas, but most of Gaza remains destroyed as a peace deal continues to stall. Recent successful recovery efforts show that species loss can still be reversed, according to a report by the environmental group WWF. The veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar, one of the most outspoken figures in the Indian film industry, has died aged 75. A BBC investigation has found workers in South East Asia are being paid less than $2 an hour to make official football shirts. Margaret Hamilton, the pioneering computer scientist who helped land US astronauts on the Moon, has died aged 90. And a man who spent 28 years walking from the UK to Chile has finally returned home.
